svg.title: MOKS investigation workflow
svg.desc: The graph runs triage, logs and skills. With a model it enters a loop of plan and act, otherwise it runs rules. Plan goes to rules on a model or budget failure, to correlate when the budget is spent or no calls are returned, and to act when calls are returned. Act returns to plan unless the model said done or no call was new, when it goes to correlate. Rules goes to correlate, then report, then the end. After the graph, code verifies causes and stores the report.
